name: Mirror Entity, Volatile Claws — '… and gain all creature types' after a base P/T or a boost
notes: 'Creatures you control have base power and toughness X/X and gain all creature types' and 'creatures you control get +2/+0 and gain all creature types': the first half was read and the type half was lost. Mirror Entity is activated with X = 3, then Volatile Claws is cast: the first player's Grizzly Bears is 5/3 and every creature type; the second player's Gray Ogre is untouched.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Mirror Entity
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
{X}: Until end of turn, creatures you control have base power and toughness X/X and gain all creature types.
scryfallData.flavor_text: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

scryfallData.name: Volatile Claws
scryfallData.oracle_text: Until end of turn, creatures you control get +2/+0 and gain all creature types.
scryfallData.flavor_text: Whether modeled after bear, bird, or baloth, all claws send the same message.
